summary: Experienced Front Range backcountry skier triggered an avalanche descending Red Lady Bowl above Crested Butte, deployed his airbag and rode about 100 yards on the surface uninjured; lost both skis, located one and skied out on a single ski; Crested Butte SAR hasty team and first RAD avalanche response deployed, helicopter from Rifle recalled once no burial was confirmed.
location: Red Lady Bowl, above Crested Butte
notes: Crested Butte News, published 2020-01-22 ('last weekend... Sunday morning'). Run 1017 chunk C.
